system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for the two-phase handshake specification. It instantiates the abstract constant operators with concrete definitions to make the specification amenable to finite model checking by TLC.
actors_and_components: Same as the TwoPhase handshake specification: a Producer and Consumer alternating via two binary control signals. This module provides concrete implementations of the parameterized data operations.
state_variables: Inherits all state variables from the TwoPhase specification: two binary control signals and a data variable.
initial_state: Both control signals start at zero. The data variable is initialized to zero (the concrete initial-state predicate requires the data to equal zero).
actions: Inherits all actions from the TwoPhase specification. The concrete action predicate for both the zeroth and first actions is the identity: the data value is left unchanged (the next data value equals the current data value).
safety_properties: Inherits the invariant from TwoPhase ensuring both control signals are binary. The implementation refinement theorem from TwoPhase also applies.
model_bounds: The data variable and control signals are bounded to small finite values. The identity action and zero-initialized data ensure the state space is minimal.
additional_assumptions: This module uses the TLA+ INSTANCE mechanism to import the TwoPhase specification with its constant parameters replaced by concrete operators. The data initial predicate requires data to equal zero. The data action predicate is the identity function (no change), making the specification trivial in the data dimension so the model checker can focus on the control protocol behavior.
